title: Choose allowed inputs
summary: Ruby on Rails: Choose allowed inputs. Add another permitted field deliberately.
introduction: permit chooses allowed parameter keys. Send POST /books with title and an extra secret key; only title is returned.
learningObjectives: Choose allowed inputs with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Choose allowed inputs
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
post "/books", to: "lesson#create"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def create
 allowed = params.permit(:title)
 render json: allowed
end
end

blocks.text: permit selects title and leaves out the unlisted key. Rendering the allowed parameters sends only that field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Permitting a key does not validate its meaning or value.
